steps.message: The patch has been submitted. I have fixed the bug where implicitly created columns in `rich.table.Table.add_row` did not inherit the `highlight` attribute from the `Table` instance. I verified the fix with a reproduction script.

The bug was located in the `rich.table.Table.add_row` method, where columns were being implicitly created when more cell renderables were provided than existing columns. These implicitly created `Column` objects were instantiated without the `highlight` attribute, causing them to default to `False` and ignore the `highlight` setting of the `Table` instance.

I fixed this by updating the `Column` instantiation in `add_row` to explicitly pass the `highlight` attribute from the `Table` instance: `Column(_index=index, highlight=self.highlight)`. This ensures consistent behavior between explicitly added columns and implicitly created ones. The fix was verified using a reproduction script.
